p1_source_scope: p1_frozen_research_source_scope_v1; same finite research corpus; operational registry unchanged

rq1.prediction_annotation: AI raw-response annotation under fixed extraction contract; never human labels
rq1.failure_policy: Keep every case including malformed, timeout and invalid outputs; annotate only observed raw assertions
rq1.completion: 36 new raw-linked complete annotations; no previous answer reuse

rq2.false_block_denominator: valid executable clean controls only; clarification and safe abstention separate
rq2.pairing: one shared reviewer response for B4/H; P0 native initial validation; 3 source-base clusters

rq3.methods: all 8 on the same GOLD-selected spatial cases
rq3.zero_success_policy: CGE and SSFR undefined/null when successful-execution denominator is zero
rq3.fault_diagnostics: 8 separately labelled real executor diagnostics; not claimed as 8-method fault mitigation results

metrics: first repair execution and joint success
rq4.eligible: recoverable fault AND independent nonempty object Oracle
rq4.success: execution success AND object restoration AND semantic preservation
rq4.empty_oracle: exclude with explicit reason, never successful recovery
rq4.permission_and_absence: safe abstention; not automatic recovery targets

rq5.cost_policy: shared generation/review unique event ledger; standalone charges each consumer in full, allocated divides by consumer count, physical totals deduplicate events. Allocated latency is work accounting, not response latency
rq5.sql_scope: all research query submissions including validator metadata; packet retrieval is file-only; atomic guard shares submission. P1 all instrumented DBAPI submissions, scope disclosed separately
rq5.evidence_policy: returned object source-hash/ID presence and machine evidence-binding checks reported separately; presence is not correctness or full-answer completeness
rq5.unknown_policy: unknown is null; no inferred zero or semantic correctness from presence of citations
rq5.evqsr_policy: machine contract joint success separate from independent human semantic quality

ablation: Table13 module-removal study is separate; this RQ1-RQ5 run does not claim ablation completion
mutation_policy: source/contract/input/model/budget immutable during run; bug requires preserved failed run and new whole freeze
k5: only after Development K1 gates; 8x18x5=720 base observations, repetitions not independent cases
